dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: Thank you so much for helping out with the troubleshooting!

response.speaker: Ginette
response.text: My robots were actually modified with devices that Aino invented, and the idea to use kuuvahki was based on one of her latest works. She's a total genius!

response.speaker: Ginette
response.text: I tried to do it myself, only to realize how difficult it actually was... I really have to learn from my seniors, don't I? Haha...

response.speaker: Ginette
response.text: Ah, those... Well, I'm not too proud to admit those initial malfunctions were all down to my "creativity." I wanted to try something novel, but ended up nearly ruining everything.

response.speaker: Ginette
response.text: But with the help of Aino's robots, even these "creative" experiments are still functioning smoothly. I have no clue how it all works, though...
